title: Device registration
description:
POST /api/bridge/devices — how a desktop announces itself to a cloud tenant and keeps a heartbeat.

An upsert on `deviceId` that also stamps `lastSeenAt`, so the registry doubles as the liveness signal: a consumer deciding whether a remote runtime exists reads freshness here rather than maintaining a second presence channel.

runtime.description: Where execution happens. A capability is offered by a runtime, not by the platform in the abstract.

protocol.description: Protocol the sender speaks. Receivers reject unknown majors rather than guessing.

deviceName.description: Human label, e.g. 'Reception PC'. Shown in run history as the claimer.

items.description: Dotted capability id. `oaiy.*` is reserved for the platform; products and plugins own their own namespace (`connector.aokie.*`).

platform.description: e.g. `windows-x86_64`. Lets a consumer explain why a platform-specific capability is missing.
